newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - July 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - July 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Moroccan banks which vie for expatriate remittances are diversifying services they offer to attract more clients and seek more branches abroad.

- Economic think tank, Centre Marocain de Conjoncture (CMC), forecasts 6.5 percent growth in 1998 because of positive trend of world economy and government policy which it expects to be constant despite probable political change.
- Customs revenue for 1997-98 forecast in budget at just under 13.5 billion dirhams ($1.4 billion), an increase of 24.87 percent.
- Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur opensd branch in Germany to attract foreign investments. Move follows Commerzbank purchase of 10 percent stake in BMCE.
- State-owned Office National d'Electricite shortlists France's Norelec to expand electricity grid in 199 villages.
